filesystem.description: Read, write, navigate, and search the local file system within sandboxed directories.

tools.name: read_text_file
tools.description: Read the complete contents of a file from the file system as text. Handles various text encodings and provides detailed error messages if the file cannot be read.

tail.description: If provided, returns only the last N lines of the file

head.description: If provided, returns only the first N lines of the file

tools.name: read_media_file
tools.description: Read an image or audio file. Returns the base64 encoded data and MIME type. Only works within allowed directories.

tools.name: read_multiple_files
tools.description: Read the contents of multiple files simultaneously. More efficient than reading files one by one when analyzing or comparing multiple files.

paths.description: Array of file paths to read within allowed directories

tools.name: write_file
tools.description: Create a new file or completely overwrite an existing file with new content. Use with caution as it will overwrite existing files without warning.

tools.name: edit_file
tools.description: Make line-based edits to a text file. Each edit replaces exact line sequences with new content. Returns a git-style diff showing the changes made.

oldText.description: Text to search for — must match exactly

dryRun.description: Preview changes using git-style diff format

tools.name: create_directory
tools.description: Create a new directory or ensure a directory exists. Can create multiple nested directories in one operation.

tools.name: list_directory
tools.description: Get a detailed listing of all files and directories in a specified path. Results distinguish between files and directories with [FILE] and [DIR] prefixes.

tools.name: list_directory_with_sizes
tools.description: Get a detailed listing of all files and directories in a specified path, including sizes. Results distinguish between files and directories.

sortBy.description: Sort entries by name or size

tools.name: directory_tree
tools.description: Get a recursive tree view of files and directories as a JSON structure. Each entry includes name, type (file/directory), and children for directories.

tools.name: move_file
tools.description: Move or rename files and directories. Can move files between directories and rename them in a single operation.

tools.name: search_files
tools.description: Recursively search for files and directories matching a pattern. Uses glob-style patterns and returns full paths to all matching items.

tools.name: get_file_info
tools.description: Retrieve detailed metadata about a file or directory. Returns information including size, creation time, last modified time, permissions, and type.

tools.name: list_allowed_directories
tools.description: Returns the list of directories that this server is allowed to access. Subdirectories within these allowed directories are also accessible.

fetch.description: Fetch web pages from the internet and convert their content to markdown for LLM consumption.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetches a URL from the internet and optionally extracts its contents as markdown. Grants internet access to retrieve up-to-date information.

max_length.description: Maximum number of characters to return

start_index.description: Character index to start output from for pagination

raw.description: Return raw HTML without simplification to markdown

memory.description: Persist and query a knowledge graph of entities, relations, and observations across sessions.

tools.name: create_entities
tools.description: Create multiple new entities in the knowledge graph.

observations.description: An array of observation contents associated with the entity

tools.name: create_relations
tools.description: Create multiple new relations between entities in the knowledge graph. Relations should be in active voice.

from.description: The name of the entity where the relation starts

to.description: The name of the entity where the relation ends

tools.name: add_observations
tools.description: Add new observations to existing entities in the knowledge graph.

entityName.description: The name of the entity to add the observations to

contents.description: An array of observation contents to add

tools.name: delete_entities
tools.description: Delete multiple entities and their associated relations from the knowledge graph.

entityNames.description: An array of entity names to delete

tools.name: delete_observations
tools.description: Delete specific observations from entities in the knowledge graph.

entityName.description: The name of the entity containing the observations

observations.description: An array of observations to delete

tools.name: delete_relations
tools.description: Delete multiple relations from the knowledge graph.

relations.description: An array of relations to delete

tools.name: read_graph
tools.description: Read the entire knowledge graph.

tools.name: search_nodes
tools.description: Search for nodes in the knowledge graph based on a query.

query.description: The search query to match against entity names, types, and observation content

tools.name: open_nodes
tools.description: Open specific nodes in the knowledge graph by their names.

names.description: An array of entity names to retrieve

sequentialthinking.description: Reason through complex problems step-by-step with branching and revision capabilities.

tools.name: sequentialthinking
tools.description: A detailed tool for dynamic and reflective problem-solving through thoughts. This tool helps analyze problems through a flexible thinking process that can adapt and evolve. Each thought can build on, question, or revise previous insights as understanding deepens.

nextThoughtNeeded.description: Whether another thought step is needed

git.description: Inspect and manipulate local Git repositories: status, diffs, commits, branches, and logs.

tools.name: git_status
tools.description: Shows the working tree status.

tools.name: git_diff_unstaged
tools.description: Shows changes in the working directory that are not yet staged.

tools.name: git_diff_staged
tools.description: Shows changes that are staged for commit.

tools.name: git_diff
tools.description: Shows differences between branches or commits.

tools.name: git_commit
tools.description: Records changes to the repository.

tools.name: git_add
tools.description: Adds file contents to the staging area.

tools.name: git_reset
tools.description: Unstages all staged changes.

tools.name: git_log
tools.description: Shows the commit logs.

start_timestamp.description: ISO 8601, relative dates, or absolute dates

end_timestamp.description: ISO 8601, relative dates, or absolute dates

tools.name: git_create_branch
tools.description: Creates a new branch from an optional base branch.

tools.name: git_checkout
tools.description: Switches branches.

tools.name: git_show
tools.description: Shows the contents of a commit.

tools.name: git_branch
tools.description: List Git branches.

repo_path.description: The path to the Git repository

contains.description: Commit SHA that branch should contain

not_contains.description: Commit SHA that branch should NOT contain

time.description: Get the current time and convert times between IANA timezones.

tools.name: get_current_time
tools.description: Get current time in a specific timezone.

tools.name: convert_time
tools.description: Convert time between timezones.

everything.description: Reference server demonstrating MCP protocol features: echo, math, sampling, elicitation, long-running operations, resources, and structured content.

tools.name: echo
tools.description: Echoes back the input string.

tools.name: get-sum
tools.description: Returns the sum of two numbers.

tools.name: get-env
tools.description: Returns all environment variables, helpful for debugging MCP server configuration.

tools.name: get-tiny-image
tools.description: Returns a tiny MCP logo image.

tools.name: get-annotated-message
tools.description: Demonstrates how annotations can be used to provide metadata about content.

messageType.description: Type of message to demonstrate different annotation patterns

includeImage.description: Whether to include an example image

tools.name: get-structured-content
tools.description: Returns structured content along with an output schema for client data validation.

tools.name: get-resource-links
tools.description: Returns up to ten resource links that reference different types of resources.

count.description: Number of resource links to return (1–10)

tools.name: get-resource-reference
tools.description: Returns a resource reference that can be used by MCP clients.

resourceId.description: ID of the text resource to fetch

tools.name: get-roots-list
tools.description: Lists the current MCP roots provided by the client. Demonstrates the roots protocol capability.

tools.name: gzip-file-as-resource
tools.description: Compresses a single file using gzip compression and returns it either as a resource or a resource link.

data.description: URL or data URI of the file content to compress

outputType.description: How the resulting gzipped file should be returned

tools.name: simulate-research-query
tools.description: Simulates a deep research operation that gathers, analyzes, and synthesizes information. Demonstrates MCP task-based operations with progress through multiple stages.

ambiguous.description: Simulate an ambiguous query that requires clarification

tools.name: trigger-long-running-operation
tools.description: Demonstrates a long running operation with progress updates.

duration.description: Duration of the operation in seconds

steps.description: Number of steps in the operation

tools.name: trigger-sampling-request
tools.description: Trigger a request from the server for LLM sampling.

prompt.description: The prompt to send to the LLM

maxTokens.description: Maximum number of tokens to generate

tools.name: trigger-sampling-request-async
tools.description: Trigger an async sampling request that the client executes as a background task. Demonstrates bidirectional MCP tasks where the server sends a request and the client executes it asynchronously.

prompt.description: The prompt to send to the LLM

maxTokens.description: Maximum number of tokens to generate

tools.name: trigger-elicitation-request
tools.description: Trigger a request from the server for user elicitation.

tools.name: trigger-elicitation-request-async
tools.description: Trigger an async elicitation request that the client executes as a background task. Demonstrates bidirectional MCP tasks where the server sends an elicitation request and the client handles user input asynchronously.

tools.name: toggle-simulated-logging
tools.description: Toggles simulated, random-leveled logging on or off.

tools.name: toggle-subscriber-updates
tools.description: Toggles simulated resource subscription updates on or off.
